content:
maya: Quick check — we need someone to flip the `eu_prefix_cache_v2` toggle tonight during the 22:00-23:00 CET window. Target rollout: staged 5% -> 25% -> 100% with 15m waits and health checks. Safe default is OFF.

dylan: I can take the 22:00 CET slot if no objections. Will run the smoke script and monitor latency + 5xx for 30m. Want the staged steps automated via the flag-orch, right? :thumbsup:

maya: Yes, use flag-orch staged rollout. Key asks: who runs the initial canary (5%), who watches APM traces, and who's the rollback owner if we see increased tail latency.

owen: I'll be on-call that window and can own APM tracing + logs. I can also trigger rollback if 95p latency > 250ms sustained for 5m or error rate > 0.5% spike over baseline.

sri: I'll queue the smoke tests (small qps, fixed prompt set) and post results to this thread. Also confirm the safe default config we push on failure is `eu_prefix_cache_v2: OFF` + `batch_size: 1`.

dylan: Plan from my side:
- 21:50 CET: preflight checks (config present, feature flag exists, rollout plan in flag-orch)
- 22:00 CET: flip to 5% (orchestrator takeover)
- 22:15 CET: if healthy -> 25%
- 22:30 CET: 100% if healthy
- 22:45-23:15 CET: extended watch
Will post smoke logs and quick grep for 5xx + p50/p95 latencies.

maya: Add small ops checklist in thread please — who flips the toggle manually if flag-orch misbehaves, and how to invoke rollback.

dylan: Manual flip command (flag-orch API):
```bash
curl -X POST "https://flag-orch.redwood.internal/api/v1/flags/eu_prefix_cache_v2/rollout" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ORCH_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"percent":5, "stages":[5,25,100], "notes":"evening pickup EU"}'
```
Manual rollback (safe default):
```bash
curl -X POST "https://flag-orch.redwood.internal/api/v1/flags/eu_prefix_cache_v2/rollback" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ORCH_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"to":"OFF", "reason":"auto/ops rollback - see thread"}'
```

dylan: If flag-orch unresponsive, manual feature toggle in config service (kvs):
```json
{
  "eu_prefix_cache_v2": "OFF",
  "fallback": { "batch_size": 1 }
}
```

sri: I'll run the smoke harness after each stage and paste this short table here: stage, qps, p50, p95, 5xx_count. Will also pin the query set used.

omens: @deploy-bot can you schedule a reminder at 21:45 CET and post the canary start event to #eng-platform? (typo: meant "deploy-bot")

deploy-bot: Reminder scheduled for 21:45 CET. Will post start + after each stage and ping @dylan @owen @sri.

own: One more note: EU region has higher cold-start variance — prefer to warm a small pool 10m before flip. I'll run a light warmup script at 21:50 CET.

dylan: Cool. Quick rollback criteria (agreed):
- p95 > 400ms for 5m
- 5xx increase > 0.5% absolute over baseline for 5m
- user-facing errors in logs containing "cache prefix mismatch"
If any of these happen, @owen triggers rollback and @dylan runs manual rollback command.

maya: Thanks. Final owners: deploy = dylan, tracing + immediate rollback = owen, smoke harness = sri. I'll be available as backup. Post the smoke table here and mark completion.

sri: Will post results after each stage. Tagging checklist: @dylan @owen @maya. :white_check_mark:

dylan: Got it. I'll update the runbook with the command snippets and handoff notes after the flip.

owen: I'll be in the channel during the window. Ping me immediately on anomalies"
